kit-cursor: Usage: put it over footage with the footage item's transform; give it the recording's sidecar as is. { "asset": "kit-cursor", "start": 0, "duration": 10.4, "transform": <footage item's>, "params": { "path": <sidecar.cursor>, "clicks": <sidecar.clicks>, "at": 0, "speed": 1 } }. With footage trimmed in: 2, use at: 2; if the footage has a kit-camera motion, give the cursor the same motion.
kit-spotlight: Usage: dims all but an element box from the recording's sidecar, in the picture's pixels (space 1440x900 by default). { "asset": "kit-spotlight", "start": 3, "duration": 3, "transform": <footage's>, "params": { "region": { "x": 24, "y": 524, "width": 228, "height": 30 }, "padding": 10 } }. Several regions in turn: "regions": [{ "t": 3.34, ...box }].
kit-camera: Usage: a motion on the footage item (and on the cursor and spotlight over it): "motions": [{ "asset": "kit-camera", "phase": "emphasis", "at": 3.3, "duration": 2.6, "params": { "region": { ...box }, "fill": 0.6 } }]. Set anchorX, anchorY and itemScale to the item's transform. Mask the footage to its box (mask transform fixed) so the zoom stays inside it.
kit-arrow: Usage: { "asset": "kit-arrow", "start": 6, "duration": 2.6, "transform": <footage's>, "params": { "from": { "x": 980, "y": 640 }, "to": { "x": 1135, "y": 540 }, "label": "Open it" } } (points in the picture's pixels).
kit-callout: Usage: a short label that points at a place in the picture and stays inside the safe area. { "asset": "kit-callout", "start": 4.2, "duration": 2.8, "transform": <footage's>, "params": { "text": "Filter by *kind*", "point": { "x": 138, "y": 539 }, "side": "auto" } }.
kit-ui-frame: Usage: a browser (or phone, tablet) around a capture: { "asset": "kit-ui-frame", "start": 0, "duration": 10, "transform": { "width": 0.9, "height": 0.9 }, "params": { "device": "browser", "content": "studio-library-search", "url": "127.0.0.1:8787", "title": "Library" } }. scale: 1 draws the capture pixel for pixel (crisp UI); overlays placed on the frame's box do not know where its viewport is, so annotate footage placed on its own instead.
kit-plate: Usage: the plate behind a group (chart, steps, a headline): { "asset": "kit-plate", "start": 0.4, "duration": 6, "params": { "eyebrow": "Growth", "title": "Views, *doubled*" }, "transform": { "space": "safe", "x": 0.5, "y": 0.5, "width": 0.9, "height": 0.8 } }.
kit-steps: Usage: steps walked while the narration goes through them: { "asset": "kit-steps", "start": 1, "duration": 8, "params": { "steps": ["Upload", "Describe", "Build", "Render"], "at": [0.5, 2.5, 4.5, 6.5] } }; or keyframe params.current. A column fits a side panel; the extra at time ticks the last step.
kit-icon: Usage: one Lucide icon (ISC) by name: { "asset": "kit-icon", "start": 1.2, "duration": 4, "params": { "name": "rocket", "weight": 2, "draw": 0.8 } }. Names are Lucide's own (house, pencil, trash-2); one weight across a video.
end-card: v3: add cta (a button), url and logoMode: svg for an uploaded SVG logo drawn as vectors; with those left out it draws exactly like v2. clipTheme: true reads the clip's theme instead of the theme param.
